title: Pushforward from an open of a coherent module with support closed in the ambient scheme is coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $j:U\to X$ the inclusion of an open subscheme and $T\subseteq X$ a closed subset with $T\subseteq U$. If $\mathcal F$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_U$-module [pqf-def-coherent] with $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)\subseteq T$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], then the pushforward $j_*\mathcal F$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module; indeed $(j_*\mathcal F)|_U=\mathcal F$ and $(j_*\mathcal F)|_{X\setminus T}=0$ (restrictions to open subschemes as in [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0CYJ (lemma-pushforward-coherent-on-open) and its proof

proof.text: *Step 1 ($j_*\mathcal F$ on $U$).* For an open $V\subseteq U$ we have $j^{-1}(V)=V$, so by the definition of the pushforward of modules [def-pc-module-pullback] $(j_*\mathcal F)(V)=\mathcal F(j^{-1}V)=\mathcal F(V)$, with the restriction maps of $\mathcal F$ and with $\mathcal O_X(V)=\mathcal O_U(V)$ acting as on $\mathcal F(V)$ ($j^\sharp_V$ is the identity for the inclusion of an open subscheme). By the definition of the restriction to the open subscheme $U$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], $(j_*\mathcal F)|_U=\mathcal F$ as $\mathcal O_U$-modules. (In Mathlib this is AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso, Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean:416.)

*Step 2 ($\mathcal F$ vanishes on $U\setminus T$).* $U\setminus T=U\cap(X\setminus T)$ is open in $U$. Let $W\subseteq U\setminus T$ be open and $s\in\mathcal F(W)$. For every $x\in W$ we have $x\notin T\supseteq\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$, so the stalk $\mathcal F_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is $0$ by the definition of the support [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base](2); hence the germs of $s$ and of $0$ at $x$ agree. Since $\mathcal F$ is a sheaf, a section is determined by its germs [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-sections-determined-by-germs] (applied to the underlying sheaf of sets of $\mathcal F$, whose stalks are those of $\mathcal F$), so $s=0$. Thus $\mathcal F(W)=0$ for every open $W\subseteq U\setminus T$.

*Step 3 ($j_*\mathcal F$ on $X\setminus T$).* $X\setminus T$ is open since $T$ is closed. For an open $V\subseteq X\setminus T$, $(j_*\mathcal F)(V)=\mathcal F(V\cap U)$ [def-pc-module-pullback], and $V\cap U$ is an open subset of $U\setminus T$, so $(j_*\mathcal F)(V)=0$ by Step 2. Hence $(j_*\mathcal F)|_{X\setminus T}=0$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits].

*Step 4 (coherence).* Since $T\subseteq U$, the opens $U$ and $X\setminus T$ cover $X$. On $U$, $(j_*\mathcal F)|_U=\mathcal F$ (Step 1) is coherent by hypothesis. On $X\setminus T$, $(j_*\mathcal F)|_{X\setminus T}=0$ (Step 3), and the zero module $0$ on an open subscheme $W$ is coherent by [pqf-def-coherent]: it is of finite type (the map $\mathcal O_W^{\oplus0}=0\to0$ is surjective), and for every open $W'\subseteq W$ the kernel of any map $\mathcal O_{W'}^{\oplus n}\to0$ is $\mathcal O_{W'}^{\oplus n}$, of finite type via the identity. Since coherence is local on an open covering [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-module-local-on-open-cover](2), $j_*\mathcal F$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against Stacks 0CYJ (tag verified: 0CYJ,coherent-lemma-pushforward-coherent-on-open); statement unchanged in content, citations added for j_* (def-pc-module-pullback), the restriction to an open subscheme (lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits) and def-pc-scheme, which are added to stmt_deps. The three-line Stacks proof is split into four steps: restriction of j_*F to U is F (definitional; Mathlib restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso), F is zero on U\T because its stalks vanish there and sections are determined by germs (lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-sections-determined-by-germs), hence j_*F is zero on X\T, and coherence follows because the zero module is coherent and coherence is local on an open covering; the last fact, used by Stacks without statement, is the new node lem-weil-pbc-coherent-module-local-on-open-cover (unsplit; no Mathlib match, Mathlib has no coherent sheaves of modules).
